column1: It is not possible to discuss here all the areas of monetary economics in which economists are pursuing active research, or to give adequate credit to all the interesting work that has been done. The topics covered and the space devoted to them reflect my own biases toward research motivated by policy questions or influential in a¤ecting the conduct of monetary policy. The field has simply exploded with new and interesting research, and at best this edition, like the earlier ones, can only scratch the surface of many topics. To those whose research has been slighted, I o¤er my apologies.
